verses.1: They will be judged by me. The powers of men and gods will be exchanged. Then they will speak together regarding judgment.
verses.2: Who will rule from the east of Zion? He will be called “the One Who Will Rule.” Before him, nations and kings will submit. His kingdom will be like a sun that shines brightly, like a cloud that spreads its light over everything.
verses.3: They will be pursued by darkness; they will walk on their feet, but they will not come in.
verses.4: I, the Lord, am the first to call out to the heavens. I, the Lord, am also the one who calls out to those who follow me.
verses.5: They saw the giants, and they feared the borders of the earth. They were terrified and trembled.
verses.6: One should help his neighbor, and to his brother, he should say, “Be strong.”
verses.7: And the strong man strengthened his hold on the lost one. He once said to the lost one, “It’s good.” Then he strengthened him with ropes, so that he wouldn’t be able to escape.
verses.8: And you, Israel, my servant Jacob, whom I have chosen from the seed of Abraham. You are my beloved.
verses.9: “For you have been strengthened from all corners of the earth and from its treasures. I call upon you, and I say to you, ‘O my servant, you have been chosen by me; do not abandon me.’”
verses.10: Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not be confused, for I am your God. I will help you and support you always, even in times of trial.
verses.11: They will be destroyed and lost in your hands. All those who are evil will become like islands, and they will be destroyed. Your enemies will be destroyed.
verses.12: Search for them, but you will not find them. Your enemies will be like islands in the sea, and like islands of destruction. Your enemies will be like islands of chaos.
verses.13: For I, the LORD your God, hold your right hand. I will speak to you and tell you, “Do not fear.” I will help you.
verses.14: Do not be afraid, Jacob! I will help you. The LORD says, “I will save you and make you holy among the Israelites.”
verses.15: Look, you have established a new kingdom in the land of Pibioi. The mountains and valleys have been transformed; everything has been renewed as before.
verses.16: His spirit will be carried away by the wind, and a storm will spread around them. But you will stand firm in the Holy Land of Israel.
verses.17: The poor and the needy ask for water and food to drink in their thirst. I, Jehovah, will answer them. I am the God of Israel; I will not abandon them.
verses.18: I will open up rivers from their sources, and in the depths of dark valleys, I will create lakes and lands suitable for those who live by the water.
verses.19: I will plant in the desert trees of shittah and hahdas, and also fig trees. I will set them in a garden, with thorns and brambles.
verses.20: So that they may fear and know, and act together, and learn from each other. For it was the hand of the LORD that did this, and it is a holy thing for Israel.
verses.21: Come here, my people! Say, “The LORD has brought your sacrifices before Him!” Say, “King Jacob.”
verses.22: They will tell us what happened to our ancestors. What have they said? Let us take a breath and find out later what will happen next, or what will be heard in the future.
verses.23: Tell these things to one another, so that we may know whether God is truly good or not. Then we will be able to distinguish between right and wrong, and we will be able to see clearly.
verses.24: You also come from exile, and your actions are motivated by suffering. He will choose among you.
verses.25: The cities are located in the desert, and they are called after my name from the east. They will bring forth products like copper and other valuable materials.
verses.26: Who can speak from the top and be heard? Who can say “Righteous one” when there is no one who speaks, no one who hears your words?
verses.27: At first, in Cyprus, they were there. And in Jerusalem, they also spread the news.
verses.28: And I see that there is no one there; there are no people either. There’s no one to give advice or to help me out.
verses.29: They all were cursed by their own actions; they were destroyed by the wind and fire.
